mails.outlet: Katherine Masiulanis, National Trust of Australia (Victoria) (reply)
mails.subject: Re: Can you help me with ancienttrees.app? The significant trees of Melbourne
mails.body:
Hi Katherine,

Thanks for your kind words, and sorry for the slow reply.

We pick the trees worth going out to see: old, big, or with a story worth
telling. And yes, only trees on public ground that anyone can go and stand in
front of. Melbourne has 16 now:
https://ancienttrees.app/melbourne

Thanks for the Trust Trees link and the Tree of the Year tip, I will go
through the Melbourne shortlist.

Your plans for tree trails around Victoria sound great, I would love to hear
more when they take shape.

And if you had to send one person to one tree in Melbourne, which would it be?

The app is live too, if you want to take it out to one of them:
https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/ancient-trees/id6806177833?l=en-GB

The app is live too, if you want to take it out to one of them:
https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/ancient-trees/id6806177833?l=en-GB

Thanks,
Hidde
mails.resend_reason: She replied on 2026-08-23 with two questions (why these trees, public land?) and had no answer; this answers her.

mails.subject: Re: Die Ancient Trees App ist da
mails.body:
Hallo Wolfgang,

vielen Dank, auch für den Beitrag im Forum mit der Dicken Marie!

Schön, dass wir die Daten aus Ihrem Register verwenden dürfen. Bei Fotos frage
ich natürlich jeden Fotografen einzeln.

Ein iPhone brauchen Sie übrigens nicht: ancienttrees.app funktioniert in jedem
Browser, auch auf dem Computer.

Welcher Baum in Münster ist Ihr Lieblingsbaum? Den würde ich gerne als Erstes
aufnehmen.

Baumstarke Grüße,
Hidde
mails.resend_reason: He wrote on 2026-09-20 granting use of the register data and posting about us in the forum; this thanks him.

mails.subject: Re: Kun je me helpen met ancienttrees.app? De oude bomen van Nederland
mails.body:
Beste Ingeborg,

Dank voor het doorsturen naar de bomenwerkgroep, leuk!

Als zij een favoriete boom hebben rond Zeist of op de Heuvelrug, hoor ik het
graag. Dan zet ik hem erop.

De app staat inmiddels ook live, ik ben benieuwd wat jullie ervan vinden:
https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/ancient-trees/id6806177833?l=en-GB

Groet,
Hidde
mails.resend_reason: She replied on 2026-08-28 that she forwarded us to the Zeist tree working group; this thanks her.
